_metadata.source: NASA Worldview (Earthdata GIBS) & Mars Atmospheric Climate Data
_metadata.service: Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) & Mars Climate Sounder (MCS)
_metadata.description: Satellite perspective observation layers, Mars dust storm tracks, atmospheric hazards, and safe routing corridors.

worldview_observation_layers.purpose: Aerosol optical depth and storm tracking algorithm calibration
3D profile of atmospheric dust, water ice clouds, and temperature soundings from 0 to 80 km altitude

global_and_regional_dust_storm_corridors.name: Hellas Impact Basin Storm Gateway
global_and_regional_dust_storm_corridors.description: Deepest depression on Mars (-7.2 km); high atmospheric pressure triggers massive convective regional storms that often evolve into planet-encircling dust events.

global_and_regional_dust_storm_corridors.name: Acidalia - Chryse Northern Frontal Storm Track
global_and_regional_dust_storm_corridors.hazard_type: Frontal Dust Storms & Wind Jet Corridor
global_and_regional_dust_storm_corridors.description: Baroclinic frontal systems pushing cold polar dust fronts southwards toward equatorial exploration sites.

global_and_regional_dust_storm_corridors.name: Solis Planum High-Plateau Storm Zone
global_and_regional_dust_storm_corridors.description: High thermal inertia and intense daytime ground heating creates severe dust devils and thermal dust lifting.

chemical_constituents: Seasonal CO2 Dry Ice Frost (-125 C)
perchlorate_and_co2_frost.impact_on_rover_materials: Toxic regolith adhesion on EVA suit seals, cryogenic thermal shock on actuators, and sub-zero brine corrosion.

dust_devil_activity.frequency: Highest during southern spring and summer (Ls 180 to 270)
dust_devil_activity.wind_speeds_ms: Up to 30 m/s inside vortex cores
dust_devil_activity.mitigation: Equip rovers with grounded chassis and ESD-protected electronics.

safe_navigation_corridors.name: Gale Crater Floor to Lower Mount Sharp
safe_navigation_corridors.reason: Crater rim provides partial wind shielding from global storm jets; predictable bedrock navigation.

safe_navigation_corridors.name: Jezero Neretva Vallis Delta Front
safe_navigation_corridors.reason: Firm deltaic sandstone; avoidance of northern boulder-choked mega-channels.
